scope: Candidate vendor-neutral pin envelope for the reviewed 3.3 V x16 SDR SDRAM families. Numerical compatibility is not a module, capacity or whole-board acceptance claim. Additional families must meet the envelope or widen it and be requalified; there is no brand whitelist.
